ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white) distal lobe coverage versus 55% low-intensity (black/dark-gray) central and basal surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black region in the fluke center extending to the median notch. Distal lobes transition to high-intensity white zones with dense, irregular dark mottling and a notable dark vertical linear cluster on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate 35-degree vertex and significant depth relative to the lobe chord.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with irregular peak-to-valley amplitudes; most pronounced on the distal edges of both lobes against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge contour with a steep upward trajectory toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of small, high-contrast white circular spots (rosettes) distributed across the central black region and along the inner margins of the white lobe patches.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant vertical linear pixel disruption (dark line) on the right lobe. Faint diagonal rake-like markings visible on the inner portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical linear scar on the right lobe; minor irregular indentation and associated dark tissue growth on the far left lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'peppered' transition zone between pigmented regions; distinct dark spot cluster at the leading edge of the left lobe's distal white region.
